sources.title: UK ETS international maritime voyages consultation - accessible webpage
UK ETS scope expansion: maritime sector

facts.source_fact: Offshore ships are confirmed to enter the domestic maritime UK ETS scope from January 2027.
The international maritime consultation separately proposes offshore-ship coverage for international voyages.
Under that proposal, offshore ships would surrender allowances for 50% of greenhouse gas emissions from international voyages.
The proposed international expansion is targeted for 2028.
The proposal applies to ships already in scope through domestic voyages or UK port emissions.
International voyage scope is proposed for journeys between a UK port and a port outside the UK.
Operators would monitor and report 100% of voyage greenhouse gas emissions under the proposal.
Only 50% of those voyage emissions would require allowance surrender under the proposal.
UK in-port emissions remain subject to 100% surrender under confirmed domestic-maritime policy.
The offshore international 50% treatment is a consultation proposal and is not yet final policy.
